Cc: Compliance Intake <security-intake@clearminthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Whistic + OneTrust onboarding for ClearMint Health

Hi David —

Thanks again for the quick intro on the call yesterday. ClearMint is kicking off a short vendor review and we'd like to get Redwood into our Whistic profile (and OneTrust mirror) by end of month. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm a single point of contact to receive upload invites for Whistic and OneTrust?
- We typically request SOC2 artifacts, a CAIQ mapping (CSV), and a signed statement of data handling for presigned S3 access.
- Are you able to provide presigned S3 URLs or do you prefer to upload directly into our portal?

I've attached our onboarding Q&A template (clearmint_onboarding_qna-v1.xlsx) for you to fill where helpful. If possible, please send a proposed evidence timeline — ClearMint prefers a 7–10 day window for initial proof ingestion.

Cheers,
Evelyn Park
Security Program Manager
ClearMint Health

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the template and clear asks. Looping in Marissa (security portal onboarding) and Ben (evidence lead) — they'll be our upload/coordination owners.

Quick answers and proposal:
- Point of contact: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com (she will accept portal invites).
- Preferred upload approach: we can do presigned S3 URLs for large artifacts and direct upload into Whistic for the questionnaire metadata.
- Evidence cadence: proposed initial window 7 business days starting Monday 2027-11-15; we can extend if scope grows.

Ben will map the CAIQ items to our internal SOC2 artifacts and send the mapping CSV. Marissa — can you confirm which Whistic access role you need to accept the invite (Owner vs. Contributor) and whether we should pre-stage the CAIQ mapping file on our side?

David

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks David. I'll accept the portal invite as Owner (that gives us the delegation we need to upload and set field-level ownership). A couple of operational items before we start the 7-day window:

1) Evidence manifest: Ben has prepared a CAIQ mapping CSV (redwood_caiq-mapping.csv) and a short manifest we'll push via presigned S3 links. Please confirm the bucket prefix you want the files staged under (ClearMint usually prefers clearmint-evidence/partner/redwood/).

2) Sensitive artifacts: For SOC2 system-level artifacts (syslog configs, KMS key rotation proof) we will send presigned URLs that expire in 72 hours. Let us know if you need longer access.

3) Ownership and contact: Please add marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com as Whistic Owner and ben.carter@redwoodinference.com as Contributor. That will let Ben complete metadata and me verify CAIQ field mappings.

4) Evidence exceptions: if ClearMint requires artifacts we cannot share (e.g., full raw access logs), we can provide scoped extracts and a notarized statement.

I'll attach the initial mapping and manifest export in a follow-up email once Ben finishes the CSV. Proposed timeline: start ingest on Mon 2027-11-15, bulk upload completed by Thu 2027-11-18, final verification Fri 2027-11-19.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations — Partner Intake
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan. We added marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com as Owner and ben.carter@redwoodinference.com as Contributor in Whistic; invite should be visible now.

Bucket prefix accepted: clearmint-evidence/partner/redwood/
We prefer presigned URLs to be valid for at least 72 hours; 72–96h is acceptable. For CAIQ mapping, please upload the CSV to the prefix and link it in Whistic as part of the profile fields.

We also received your note about scoped extracts for logs — that's fine; please include a short provenance statement (who pulled the extract, date range, and a SHA256 checksum) so our audit team can validate ingestion.

I'll start the ingest queue once your manifest shows up and will ping if any field-level issues arise.

Best,
Security Intake Team
ClearMint Health
